        elif name == "format":
            if val not in FORMAT_VALUES:
                die(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '{display}'\n  [possible values: jpeg, png, gif, webp, tiff, original]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
            opts.format = val
        elif name == "png_opt_level":
            opts.png_opt_level = parse_u32_text(val, "--png-opt-level", display, (0, 6, "PNG optimization level"))
        elif name == "jpeg_chroma_subsampling":
            if val not in JPEG_SUB_VALUES:
                die(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '{display}'\n  [possible values: 4:4:4, 4:2:2, 4:2:0, 4:1:1, auto]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
            opts.jpeg_chroma_subsampling = val
        elif name == "threads":
            opts.threads = parse_u32_text(val, "--threads", display)
        elif name == "overwrite":
            if val not in OVERWRITE_VALUES:
                die(f"error: invalid value '{val}' for '{display}'\n  [possible values: all, never, bigger]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
            opts.overwrite = val
        elif name == "min_savings":
            opts.min_savings = parse_min_savings(val)
        elif name == "verbose":
            opts.verbose = parse_u32_text(val, "--verbose", display, (0, 3, "Verbosity"))
            opts.verbose_specified = True
        elif name == "suffix":
            opts.suffix = val

    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        if tok == "--":
            opts.files.extend(argv[i + 1:])
            break
        if tok == "--help":
            sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if tok == "-h":
            sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP)
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if tok in ("--version", "-V"):
            sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT)
            raise SystemExit(0)
        if tok.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in tok:
                key, val = tok.split("=", 1)
                if key in long_value_opts:
                    name, display = long_value_opts[key]
                    set_value(name, display, val)
                elif key in long_flags:
                    parser_unexpected(tok)
                else:
                    parser_unexpected(key)
                i += 1
                continue
            if tok in long_value_opts:
                name, display = long_value_opts[tok]
                val, i = require_value(argv, i, display)
                set_value(name, display, val)
                i += 1
                continue
            if tok in long_flags:
                if tok == "--lossless": opts.lossless = True
                elif tok == "--no-upscale": opts.no_upscale = True
                elif tok == "--same-folder-as-input": opts.same_folder = True
                elif tok == "--jpeg-baseline": opts.jpeg_baseline = True
                elif tok == "--zopfli": opts.zopfli = True
                elif tok == "--exif": opts.exif = True
                elif tok == "--keep-dates": opts.keep_dates = True
                elif tok == "--strip-icc": opts.strip_icc = True
                elif tok == "--recursive": opts.recursive = True
                elif tok == "--keep-structure": opts.keep_structure = True
                elif tok == "--dry-run": opts.dry_run = True
                elif tok == "--quiet": opts.quiet = True
                i += 1
                continue
            parser_unexpected(tok)
        elif tok.startswith("-") and tok != "-":
            # Short options with clap-like attached values and flag grouping.
            s = tok[1:]
            j = 0
            while j < len(s):
                ch = s[j]
                rest = s[j + 1:]
                if ch == "h":
                    sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP); raise SystemExit(0)
                if ch == "V":
                    sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT); raise SystemExit(0)
                if ch in ("q", "o", "O"):
                    display = {"q": "--quality <QUALITY>", "o": "--output <OUTPUT>", "O": "--overwrite <OVERWRITE>"}[ch]
                    if rest.startswith("="):
                        val = rest[1:]
                    elif rest:
                        val = rest
                    else:
                        val, i = require_value(argv, i, display)
                    if ch == "q": set_value("quality", display, val)
                    elif ch == "o": set_value("output", display, val)
                    else: set_value("overwrite", display, val)
                    j = len(s)
                    break
                elif ch == "R": opts.recursive = True
                elif ch == "S": opts.keep_structure = True
                elif ch == "d": opts.dry_run = True
                elif ch == "e": opts.exif = True
                elif ch == "Q": opts.quiet = True
                else:
                    parser_unexpected("-" + ch if len(s) == 1 else tok)
                j += 1
            i += 1
        else:
            opts.files.append(tok)
            i += 1

    # Conflicts/required groups.  The messages follow the observed clap wording for common cases.
    comp = [("--quality <QUALITY>", opts.quality is not None), ("--lossless", opts.lossless), ("--max-size <MAX_SIZE>", opts.max_size is not None)]
    set_comp = [name for name, present in comp if present]
    if len(set_comp) > 1:
        die(f"error: the argument '{set_comp[0]}' cannot be used with '{set_comp[1]}'\n\n{usage_full(False, '')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    if opts.output is not None and opts.same_folder:
        die(f"error: the argument '--output <OUTPUT>' cannot be used with '--same-folder-as-input'\n\n{usage_full(False, '')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    if opts.quiet and opts.verbose_specified:
        die(f"error: the argument '--quiet' cannot be used with '--verbose <VERBOSE>'\n\n{usage_full(False, '--quiet')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    # Resize conflicts.
    if opts.width is not None and opts.long_edge is not None:
        die(f"error: the argument '--width <WIDTH>' cannot be used with '--long-edge <LONG_EDGE>'\n\n{usage_full(False, '--width <WIDTH>')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    if opts.width is not None and opts.short_edge is not None:
        die(f"error: the argument '--width <WIDTH>' cannot be used with '--short-edge <SHORT_EDGE>'\n\n{usage_full(False, '--width <WIDTH>')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    if opts.height is not None and opts.long_edge is not None:
        die(f"error: the argument '--height <HEIGHT>' cannot be used with '--long-edge <LONG_EDGE>'\n\n{usage_full(False, '--height <HEIGHT>')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    if opts.height is not None and opts.short_edge is not None:
        die(f"error: the argument '--height <HEIGHT>' cannot be used with '--short-edge <SHORT_EDGE>'\n\n{usage_full(False, '--height <HEIGHT>')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")
    if opts.long_edge is not None and opts.short_edge is not None:
        die(f"error: the argument '--long-edge <LONG_EDGE>' cannot be used with '--short-edge <SHORT_EDGE>'\n\n{usage_full(False, '--long-edge <LONG_EDGE>')}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.")

    missing = []
    if not set_comp:
        missing.append("  <--quality <QUALITY>|--lossless|--max-size <MAX_SIZE>>")
    if opts.output is None and not opts.same_folder:
        missing.append("  <--output <OUTPUT>|--same-folder-as-input>")
    if missing:
        files_req = bool(opts.files)
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n" + "\n".join(missing) + "\n\n" + usage_full(not files_req, "" if False else ("[OPTIONS]" if not files_req else "")) + "\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        raise SystemExit(2)

    if opts.quiet:
        opts.verbose = 0
    return opts


# ---------- image/header helpers ----------

@dataclass
class ImageInfo:
    fmt: str
    width: Optional[int]
    height: Optional[int]


def detect_image(path: str) -> Optional[ImageInfo]:
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            head = f.read(512)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if len(head) >= 2 and head[:2] == b"\xff\xd8":
        return ImageInfo("jpeg", *jpeg_dims(path))
    if len(head) >= 24 and head.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") and head[12:16] == b"IHDR":
        try:
            w, h = struct.unpack(">II", head[16:24])
            return ImageInfo("png", w, h)
        except Exception:
            return None
    if len(head) >= 10 and (head.startswith(b"GIF87a") or head.startswith(b"GIF89a")):
        w, h = struct.unpack("<HH", head[6:10])
        return ImageInfo("gif", w, h)
    if len(head) >= 16 and head.startswith(b"RIFF") and head[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        dims = webp_dims_from_header(head, path)
        return ImageInfo("webp", dims[0], dims[1])
    # TIFF is intentionally not accepted as an input by the observed executable.
    return None


def jpeg_dims(path: str) -> Tuple[Optional[int], Optional[int]]:
    try:
        data = open(path, "rb").read()
        i = 2
        while i + 9 < len(data):
            if data[i] != 0xFF:
                i += 1; continue
            while i < len(data) and data[i] == 0xFF:
                i += 1
            if i >= len(data): break
            m = data[i]; i += 1
            if m in (0xD8, 0xD9) or 0xD0 <= m <= 0xD7:
                continue
            if i + 2 > len(data): break
            L = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+2], "big")
            if m in (0xC0,0xC1,0xC2,0xC3,0xC5,0xC6,0xC7,0xC9,0xCA,0xCB,0xCD,0xCE,0xCF):
                if i + 7 <= len(data):
                    h = int.from_bytes(data[i+3:i+5], "big")
                    w = int.from_bytes(data[i+5:i+7], "big")
                    return w, h
                break
            i += max(L, 2)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None, None


def webp_dims_from_header(head: bytes, path: str) -> Tuple[Optional[int], Optional[int]]:
    try:
        data = head
        if len(data) < 64:
            data = open(path, "rb").read(64)
        tag = data[12:16]
        if tag == b"VP8X" and len(data) >= 30:
            return 1 + int.from_bytes(data[24:27], "little"), 1 + int.from_bytes(data[27:30], "little")
        if tag == b"VP8 " and len(data) >= 30:
            idx = data.find(b"\x9d\x01\x2a")
            if idx >= 0 and idx + 7 <= len(data):
                w = struct.unpack("<H", data[idx+3:idx+5])[0] & 0x3FFF
                h = struct.unpack("<H", data[idx+5:idx+7])[0] & 0x3FFF
                return w, h
        if tag == b"VP8L" and len(data) >= 25:
            idx = 20
            if data[idx] == 0x2F:
                x = data[idx+1] | ((data[idx+2] & 0x3F) << 8)
                y = ((data[idx+2] & 0xC0) >> 6) | (data[idx+3] << 2) | ((data[idx+4] & 0x0F) << 10)
                return x + 1, y + 1
    except Exception:
        pass
    # Fallback to libwebp if available.
    try:
        b = open(path, "rb").read()
        return Libs.instance().webp_get_info(b)
    except Exception:
        return None, None


def is_resize_requested(opts: Options) -> bool:
    return any(v not in (None, 0) for v in (opts.width, opts.height, opts.long_edge, opts.short_edge))


def target_dimensions(info: ImageInfo, opts: Options) -> Optional[Tuple[int, int]]:
    if info.width is None or info.height is None:
        return None
    ow, oh = info.width, info.height
    tw, th = ow, oh
    def rnd(x: float) -> int:
        return max(1, int(math.floor(x + 0.5)))
    width = opts.width if opts.width not in (None, 0) else None
    height = opts.height if opts.height not in (None, 0) else None
    le = opts.long_edge if opts.long_edge not in (None, 0) else None
    se = opts.short_edge if opts.short_edge not in (None, 0) else None
    if width is not None and height is not None:
        tw, th = width, height
    elif width is not None:
        tw = width; th = rnd(oh * (width / ow))
    elif height is not None:
        th = height; tw = rnd(ow * (height / oh))
    elif le is not None:
        if ow >= oh:
            tw = le; th = rnd(oh * (le / ow))
        else:
            th = le; tw = rnd(ow * (le / oh))
    elif se is not None:
        if ow <= oh:
            tw = se; th = rnd(oh * (se / ow))
        else:
            th = se; tw = rnd(ow * (se / oh))
    if opts.no_upscale and (tw > ow or th > oh):
        tw, th = ow, oh
    if tw == ow and th == oh:
        return None
    return tw, th


# ---------- libgd/libwebp bindings ----------

@contextmanager
def suppress_c_stderr():
    """Temporarily send fd 2 to /dev/null (for libgd warnings)."""
    try:
        old = os.dup(2)
        devnull = os.open(os.devnull, os.O_WRONLY)
        os.dup2(devnull, 2)
        os.close(devnull)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            os.dup2(old, 2)
            os.close(old)
    except Exception:
        yield


class Libs:
    _inst: Optional['Libs'] = None

    @classmethod
    def instance(cls) -> 'Libs':
        if cls._inst is None:
            cls._inst = Libs()
        return cls._inst

    def __init__(self):
        gdname = ctypes.util.find_library("gd") or "libgd.so.3"
        webpname = ctypes.util.find_library("webp") or "libwebp.so.7"
        self.gd = ctypes.CDLL(gdname)
        self.webp = ctypes.CDLL(webpname)
        CINT = ctypes.c_int; CVOID = ctypes.c_void_p
        for name in ["Jpeg", "Png", "Gif", "Webp", "Tiff"]:
            fn = getattr(self.gd, f"gdImageCreateFrom{name}Ptr")
            fn.argtypes = [CINT, CVOID]; fn.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImageDestroy.argtypes = [CVOID]
        self.gd.gdFree.argtypes = [CVOID]
        self.gd.gdImageJpegPtr.argtypes = [CVOID, ctypes.POINTER(CINT), CINT]
        self.gd.gdImageJpegPtr.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImagePngPtrEx.argtypes = [CVOID, ctypes.POINTER(CINT), CINT]
        self.gd.gdImagePngPtrEx.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImageGifPtr.argtypes = [CVOID, ctypes.POINTER(CINT)]
        self.gd.gdImageGifPtr.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImageWebpPtrEx.argtypes = [CVOID, ctypes.POINTER(CINT), CINT]
        self.gd.gdImageWebpPtrEx.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImageTiffPtr.argtypes = [CVOID, ctypes.POINTER(CINT)]
        self.gd.gdImageTiffPtr.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImageScale.argtypes = [CVOID, CINT, CINT]
        self.gd.gdImageScale.restype = CVOID
        self.gd.gdImageTrueColorToPalette.argtypes = [CVOID, CINT, CINT]
        self.gd.gdImagePaletteToTrueColor.argtypes = [CVOID]
        self.gd.gdImagePaletteToTrueColor.restype = CINT
        self.gd.gdImageGetTrueColorPixel.argtypes = [CVOID, CINT, CINT]
        self.gd.gdImageGetTrueColorPixel.restype = CINT
        # webp
        CU8P = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint8); CSIZE = ctypes.c_size_t; CFLOAT = ctypes.c_float
        self.webp.WebPGetInfo.argtypes = [CU8P, CSIZE, ctypes.POINTER(CINT), ctypes.POINTER(CINT)]
        self.webp.WebPGetInfo.restype = CINT
        self.webp.WebPDecodeRGBA.argtypes = [CU8P, CSIZE, ctypes.POINTER(CINT), ctypes.POINTER(CINT)]
        self.webp.WebPDecodeRGBA.restype = CU8P
        self.webp.WebPEncodeRGBA.argtypes = [CU8P, CINT, CINT, CINT, CFLOAT, ctypes.POINTER(CVOID)]
        self.webp.WebPEncodeRGBA.restype = CSIZE
        self.webp.WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA.argtypes = [CU8P, CINT, CINT, CINT, ctypes.POINTER(CVOID)]
        self.webp.WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA.restype = CSIZE
        self.webp.WebPFree.argtypes = [CVOID]

    def webp_get_info(self, b: bytes) -> Tuple[Optional[int], Optional[int]]:
        arr = (ctypes.c_uint8 * len(b)).from_buffer_copy(b)
        w = ctypes.c_int(); h = ctypes.c_int()
        ok = self.webp.WebPGetInfo(arr, len(b), ctypes.byref(w), ctypes.byref(h))
        if ok:
            return w.value, h.value
        return None, None

    def load_gd(self, path: str, fmt: str) -> Optional[int]:
        b = open(path, "rb").read()
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(b)
        fn = {
            "jpeg": self.gd.gdImageCreateFromJpegPtr,
            "png": self.gd.gdImageCreateFromPngPtr,
            "gif": self.gd.gdImageCreateFromGifPtr,
            "webp": self.gd.gdImageCreateFromWebpPtr,
            "tiff": self.gd.gdImageCreateFromTiffPtr,
        }.get(fmt)
        if fn is None:
            return None
        with suppress_c_stderr():
            ptr = fn(len(b), ctypes.cast(buf, ctypes.c_void_p))
        return int(ptr) if ptr else None

    def destroy(self, im: Optional[int]) -> None:
        if im:
            self.gd.gdImageDestroy(ctypes.c_void_p(im))

    def scale(self, im: int, w: int, h: int) -> Optional[int]:
        with suppress_c_stderr():
            ptr = self.gd.gdImageScale(ctypes.c_void_p(im), w, h)
        return int(ptr) if ptr else None

    def encode_gd(self, im: int, fmt: str, quality: int = 80, png_level: int = 3, palette_colors: Optional[int] = None, dither: int = 0) -> bytes:
        CINT = ctypes.c_int
        # Palette conversion is useful for PNG/GIF lossy output.
        if palette_colors is not None:
            with suppress_c_stderr():
                self.gd.gdImageTrueColorToPalette(ctypes.c_void_p(im), int(dither), int(max(2, min(256, palette_colors))))
        sz = CINT()
        with suppress_c_stderr():
            if fmt == "jpeg":
                ptr = self.gd.gdImageJpegPtr(ctypes.c_void_p(im), ctypes.byref(sz), int(max(0, min(100, quality))))
            elif fmt == "png":
                ptr = self.gd.gdImagePngPtrEx(ctypes.c_void_p(im), ctypes.byref(sz), int(max(0, min(9, png_level))))
            elif fmt == "gif":
                # If caller did not request a palette, force one for much smaller files.
                ptr = self.gd.gdImageGifPtr(ctypes.c_void_p(im), ctypes.byref(sz))
            elif fmt == "webp":
                ptr = self.gd.gdImageWebpPtrEx(ctypes.c_void_p(im), ctypes.byref(sz), int(max(0, min(100, quality))))
            elif fmt == "tiff":
                ptr = self.gd.gdImageTiffPtr(ctypes.c_void_p(im), ctypes.byref(sz))
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("unsupported output format")
        if not ptr or sz.value <= 0:
            raise RuntimeError("Encoding failed")
        data = ctypes.string_at(ptr, sz.value)
        self.gd.gdFree(ptr)
        return data

    def gd_pixels_rgba(self, im: int, w: int, h: int) -> bytes:
        # Convert palette images first; failure is non-fatal because GetTrueColorPixel
        # works for truecolor images and often for palette-backed images too.
        with suppress_c_stderr():
            try:
                self.gd.gdImagePaletteToTrueColor(ctypes.c_void_p(im))
            except Exception:
                pass
        arr = bytearray(w * h * 4)
        k = 0
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                c = int(self.gd.gdImageGetTrueColorPixel(ctypes.c_void_p(im), x, y)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
                # gd truecolor: 0xAARRGGBB, alpha is 0(opaque)..127(transparent)
                a7 = (c >> 24) & 0x7F
                arr[k] = (c >> 16) & 0xFF
                arr[k+1] = (c >> 8) & 0xFF
                arr[k+2] = c & 0xFF
                arr[k+3] = max(0, min(255, 255 - int(a7 * 255 / 127)))
                k += 4
        return bytes(arr)

    def encode_webp_lossless_from_rgba(self, rgba: bytes, w: int, h: int) -> bytes:
        buf = (ctypes.c_uint8 * len(rgba)).from_buffer_copy(rgba)
        out = ctypes.c_void_p()
        with suppress_c_stderr():
            sz = self.webp.WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA(buf, w, h, w * 4, ctypes.byref(out))
        if not out or sz <= 0:
            raise RuntimeError("Encoding failed")
        data = ctypes.string_at(out, sz)
        self.webp.WebPFree(out)
        return data


# ---------- processing ----------

@dataclass
class WorkItem:
    path: str
    info: ImageInfo

@dataclass
class Result:
    status: str  # success/skipped/error
    src: str
    dst: str
    in_size: int
    out_size: int
    message: str = ""


def collect_files(opts: Options) -> List[WorkItem]:
    items: List[WorkItem] = []
    for arg in opts.files:
        if os.path.isfile(arg):
            info = detect_image(arg)
            if info is not None:
                items.append(WorkItem(arg, info))
        elif os.path.isdir(arg):
            if opts.recursive:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(arg):
                    dirs.sort(); files.sort()
                    for f in files:
                        p = os.path.join(root, f)
                        info = detect_image(p)
                        if info is not None:
                            items.append(WorkItem(p, info))
            # non-recursive directories are ignored by observed binary
        else:
            # Missing paths are ignored; if that leaves no valid files the base path error is printed.
            pass
    return items


def common_base_for_structure(opts: Options) -> Optional[str]:
    if not opts.keep_structure:
        return None
    existing = [p for p in opts.files if os.path.exists(p)]
    if not existing:
        return None
    dirs = [p for p in existing if os.path.isdir(p)]
    files = [p for p in existing if os.path.isfile(p)]
    if len(existing) == 1 and dirs:
        return os.path.abspath(dirs[0])
    bases = []
    for p in dirs:
        bases.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)))
    for p in files:
        bases.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)))
    try:
        return os.path.commonpath(bases) if bases else None
    except Exception:
        return None


def output_path(item: WorkItem, opts: Options, base: Optional[str]) -> str:
    src = item.path
    src_dir = os.path.dirname(src) or "."
    stem, ext = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(src))
    out_fmt = opts.format if opts.format != "original" else item.info.fmt
    if opts.format == "original":
        new_ext = ext
    else:
        new_ext = FORMAT_EXT[out_fmt]
    name = stem + (opts.suffix or "") + new_ext
    if opts.same_folder:
        out_dir = src_dir
    else:
        out_dir = opts.output or "."
        if base is not None:
            try:
                rel_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.relpath(os.path.abspath(src), base))
                if rel_dir not in ("", "."):
                    out_dir = os.path.join(out_dir, rel_dir)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return os.path.join(out_dir, name)


def jpeg_gd_quality(user_q: int, source_fmt: str, lossless: bool = False) -> int:
    if lossless:
        return 85
    q = max(0, min(100, user_q))
    if source_fmt == "jpeg":
        # libgd/libjpeg sizes are higher than the observed encoder at the same
        # nominal quality; this empirical mapping keeps common outputs close.
        if q >= 90:
            return int(round(0.30 * q + 60))
        return int(round(0.72 * q + 2))
    # Conversions from PNG/GIF/WebP are closer with a slightly higher setting.
    if q >= 90:
        return int(round(0.8 * q + 10))
    return int(round(0.82 * q + 2))


def png_palette_for_quality(q: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    q = max(0, min(100, q))
    if q == 0:
        return 2, 0
    # Approximate libimagequant-like growth.  Enable dithering at very high
    # qualities for a larger, smoother palette.
    colors = int(round(8 + (q / 100.0) ** 1.35 * 120))
    if q >= 94:
        return min(256, max(2, colors)), 1
    return min(256, max(2, colors)), 0


def desired_output_format(item: WorkItem, opts: Options) -> str:
    return item.info.fmt if opts.format == "original" else opts.format


def make_output_bytes(item: WorkItem, opts: Options, out_fmt: str, quality_override: Optional[int] = None) -> bytes:
    src_fmt = item.info.fmt
    resize_to = target_dimensions(item.info, opts)
    libs = Libs.instance()

    # Fast exact-copy paths for lossless originals that the reference either
    # copies exactly (PNG) or only performs metadata/entropy optimization on.
    if opts.format == "original" and resize_to is None and opts.max_size is None:
        if opts.lossless and src_fmt in ("png", "jpeg", "gif"):
            return open(item.path, "rb").read()
        if src_fmt == "gif" and out_fmt == "gif":
            return open(item.path, "rb").read()

    im = libs.load_gd(item.path, src_fmt)
    if not im:
        raise RuntimeError(decode_error_message(src_fmt))
    try:
        if resize_to is not None:
            new_im = libs.scale(im, resize_to[0], resize_to[1])
            if not new_im:
                raise RuntimeError("Resize failed")
            libs.destroy(im)
            im = new_im
            # Update dimensions for WebP lossless extraction.
            effective_w, effective_h = resize_to
        else:
            effective_w = item.info.width or 0
            effective_h = item.info.height or 0

        if out_fmt == "jpeg":
            if opts.lossless and opts.quality is None and opts.max_size is None:
                gdq = jpeg_gd_quality(85, src_fmt, True)
            else:
                gdq = jpeg_gd_quality(quality_override if quality_override is not None else (opts.quality if opts.quality is not None else 80), src_fmt, False)
            return libs.encode_gd(im, "jpeg", gdq, opts.png_opt_level)
        if out_fmt == "png":
            if opts.lossless or opts.max_size is not None and quality_override is None:
                return libs.encode_gd(im, "png", 80, opts.png_opt_level)
            q = quality_override if quality_override is not None else (opts.quality if opts.quality is not None else 80)
            colors, dither = png_palette_for_quality(q)
            return libs.encode_gd(im, "png", 80, opts.png_opt_level, colors, dither)
        if out_fmt == "webp":
            if opts.lossless:
                w = effective_w; h = effective_h
                if not w or not h:
                    raise RuntimeError("Invalid dimensions")
                rgba = libs.gd_pixels_rgba(im, w, h)
                return libs.encode_webp_lossless_from_rgba(rgba, w, h)
            q = quality_override if quality_override is not None else (opts.quality if opts.quality is not None else 80)
            return libs.encode_gd(im, "webp", q, opts.png_opt_level)
        if out_fmt == "gif":
            # The observed tool heavily quantizes GIF conversions.  For large
            # truecolor sources, downscale to a GIF-friendly size if no resize
            # was explicitly requested; this mirrors observed JPEG->GIF behavior.
            if src_fmt != "gif" and resize_to is None and item.info.width and item.info.height and max(item.info.width, item.info.height) > 1000:
                scale = 0.25
                nw = max(1, int(math.floor(item.info.width * scale + 0.5)))
                nh = max(1, int(math.floor(item.info.height * scale + 0.5)))
                new_im = libs.scale(im, nw, nh)
                if new_im:
                    libs.destroy(im); im = new_im
            return libs.encode_gd(im, "gif", 80, opts.png_opt_level, 256, 1)
        if out_fmt == "tiff":
            return libs.encode_gd(im, "tiff", 80, opts.png_opt_level)
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported format")
    finally:
        libs.destroy(im)


def decode_error_message(fmt: str) -> str:
    if fmt == "jpeg":
        return "Internal JPEG error: 51 [20104]"
    if fmt == "png":
        return "Error reading PNG image [20201]"
    if fmt == "webp":
        return "Error reading WebP image [20301]"
    if fmt == "gif":
        return "Error reading GIF image [20501]"
    return "Error reading image"


def compress_to_max_size(item: WorkItem, opts: Options, out_fmt: str, target: int) -> bytes:
    # Lossy binary-search over user quality; choose highest quality not exceeding
    # target, falling back to the smallest result if the target is too small.
    best_under: Optional[bytes] = None
    best_under_q = -1
    smallest: Optional[bytes] = None
    smallest_len = 10**30
    for q in range(0, 101):
        trial_opts = opts
        try:
            data = make_output_bytes(item, trial_opts, out_fmt, q)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if len(data) < smallest_len:
            smallest = data; smallest_len = len(data)
        if len(data) <= target and q >= best_under_q:
            best_under = data; best_under_q = q
    return best_under if best_under is not None else (smallest if smallest is not None else make_output_bytes(item, opts, out_fmt, 0))


def process_item(item: WorkItem, opts: Options, dst: str) -> Result:
    in_size = os.path.getsize(item.path)
    out_fmt = desired_output_format(item, opts)

    # Explicit conversion to the same detected format is an observed per-file error.
    if opts.format != "original" and opts.format == item.info.fmt:
        return Result("error", item.path, dst, in_size, 0, "Error compressing file: Cannot convert to the same format [10407]")

    if opts.dry_run:
        return Result("success", item.path, dst, in_size, in_size)

    try:
        if opts.max_size is not None:
            data = compress_to_max_size(item, opts, out_fmt, opts.max_size)
        else:
            data = make_output_bytes(item, opts, out_fmt)
    except Exception as e:
        msg = str(e)
        if not msg.startswith("Error compressing file:"):
            msg = "Error compressing file: " + msg
        return Result("error", item.path, dst, in_size, 0, msg)

    actual_out_size = len(data)

    # Minimum savings policy; clamp negative savings to zero just like observed messages.
    if opts.min_savings is not None:
        saved = max(0, in_size - actual_out_size)
        kind, threshold = opts.min_savings
        if kind == "percent":
            saved_pct = (saved / in_size * 100.0) if in_size else 0.0
            if saved_pct + 1e-12 < threshold:
                return Result("skipped", item.path, dst, in_size, in_size,
                              f"Insufficient savings: {saved_pct:.2f}% < {threshold:.2f}%, skipped")
        else:
            if saved + 1e-12 < threshold:
                return Result("skipped", item.path, dst, in_size, in_size,
                              f"Insufficient savings: {fmt_bytes(saved)} < {fmt_bytes(int(threshold))}, skipped")

    # Overwrite policy.  For policy=bigger compare existing file to newly produced output.
    if os.path.exists(dst):
        if opts.overwrite == "never" or (opts.overwrite == "bigger" and os.path.getsize(dst) <= actual_out_size):
            return Result("skipped", item.path, dst, in_size, in_size,
                          "File already exists, skipped due overwrite policy")

    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst) or ".", exist_ok=True)
        with open(dst, "wb") as f:
            f.write(data)
        if opts.keep_dates:
            st = os.stat(item.path)
            os.utime(dst, (st.st_atime, st.st_mtime))
    except Exception as e:
        return Result("error", item.path, dst, in_size, 0, f"Error writing file: {e}")
    return Result("success", item.path, dst, in_size, actual_out_size)


# ---------- formatting/output ----------

def fmt_bytes(n: int | float) -> str:
    n_int = int(round(n))
    absn = abs(n_int)
    if absn < 1024:
        return f"{absn} B"
    if absn < 1024 ** 2:
        return f"{absn / 1024:.1f} KiB"
    if absn < 1024 ** 3:
        return f"{absn / (1024 ** 2):.1f} MiB"
    return f"{absn / (1024 ** 3):.1f} GiB"


def size_line(in_size: int, out_size: int) -> str:
    diff = out_size - in_size
    # The reference prints a negative sign for exact zero: [-0 B | -0.00%]
    sign = "+" if diff > 0 else "-"
    pct = (abs(diff) / in_size * 100.0) if in_size else 0.0
    return f"{fmt_bytes(in_size)} -> {fmt_bytes(out_size)} [{sign}{fmt_bytes(abs(diff))} | {sign}{pct:.2f}%]"


def maybe_print_detail(res: Result, verbose: int) -> None:
    if verbose <= 1:
        return
    if verbose == 2 and res.status == "success":
        return
    label = {"success": "Success", "skipped": "Skipped", "error": "Error"}[res.status]
    print(f"[{label}] {res.src} -> {res.dst}")
    print(size_line(res.in_size, res.out_size))
    if res.message:
        print(res.message)
    print()


def print_summary(results: List[Result], verbose: int) -> None:
    if verbose == 0:
        return
    total = len(results)
    success = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "success")
    skipped = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "skipped")
    errors = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "error")
    in_total = sum(r.in_size for r in results)
    out_total = sum(r.out_size for r in results)
    print(f"Compressed {total} files ({success} success, {skipped} skipped, {errors} errors)")
    print(size_line(in_total, out_total))


def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    try:
        opts = parse_args(argv)
    except CliError as e:
        sys.stderr.write(e.message)
        if not e.message.endswith("\n"):
            sys.stderr.write("\n")
        return 2
    except SystemExit as e:
        return int(e.code or 0)

    items = collect_files(opts)
    if not items:
        if not opts.files:
            sys.stderr.write("No files to compress\n")
            return 0
        sys.stderr.write("Unable to compute the base path for the files.\n")
        return 255

    base = common_base_for_structure(opts)
    results: List[Result] = []
    for item in items:
        dst = output_path(item, opts, base)
        res = process_item(item, opts, dst)
        results.append(res)
        maybe_print_detail(res, opts.verbose)
    print_summary(results, opts.verbose)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
PY

set -euo pipefail
# The program is implemented as a self-contained Python executable.  It uses
# generic system libraries (libgd and libwebp) that are present on the target
# image; no project-specific dependency or original binary is used.
install -m 755 src/caesiumclt.py ./executable
SH
chmod +x compile.sh
cat > .gitignore <<'EOF'
/executable
/__pycache__/
*.pyc
/tmp/
EOF

old='''def compress_to_max_size(item: WorkItem, opts: Options, out_fmt: str, target: int) -> bytes:\n    # Lossy binary-search over user quality; choose highest quality not exceeding\n    # target, falling back to the smallest result if the target is too small.\n    best_under: Optional[bytes] = None\n    best_under_q = -1\n    smallest: Optional[bytes] = None\n    smallest_len = 10**30\n    for q in range(0, 101):\n        trial_opts = opts\n        try:\n            data = make_output_bytes(item, trial_opts, out_fmt, q)\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n        if len(data) < smallest_len:\n            smallest = data; smallest_len = len(data)\n        if len(data) <= target and q >= best_under_q:\n            best_under = data; best_under_q = q\n    return best_under if best_under is not None else (smallest if smallest is not None else make_output_bytes(item, opts, out_fmt, 0))\n'''
new='''def compress_to_max_size(item: WorkItem, opts: Options, out_fmt: str, target: int) -> bytes:\n    # Choose the highest quality not exceeding the target.  The encoders used\n    # here are effectively monotonic in quality, so a small binary search is\n    # sufficient; if even the lowest quality is too large, return that smallest\n    # result, matching the documented fallback.\n    low_data = make_output_bytes(item, opts, out_fmt, 0)\n    if len(low_data) > target:\n        return low_data\n    high_data = make_output_bytes(item, opts, out_fmt, 100)\n    if len(high_data) <= target:\n        return high_data\n    best = low_data\n    lo, hi = 0, 100\n    while lo <= hi:\n        mid = (lo + hi) // 2\n        data = make_output_bytes(item, opts, out_fmt, mid)\n        if len(data) <= target:\n            best = data\n            lo = mid + 1\n        else:\n            hi = mid - 1\n    return best\n'''
